name: Palo Brunch Roasted Red Snapper Filet with Saffron Fondant Potato
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Brunch)
whyItWorks: Flaky pan-roasted red snapper and peeled saffron fondant potato are lean, dairy-light, citrus-free, and flare-safe once the caponata relish is held.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Roasted Red Snapper with the saffron fondant potatoes only—ask the kitchen to hold the Sicilian eggplant/olive caponata relish.
watchOuts: Eggplant/olive/tomato caponata garnish if not held
